blocks.text: from Mount Tan'eem with the express purpose of ambushing Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA). However, they were captured when Rasulullaah ﷺ made a du'aa to Allaah. Rasulullaah ﷺ then forgave them, after which Allaah revealed the verse:

blocks.arabic_text: وَهُوَ الَّذِي كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِن بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا
blocks.text: It is Allaah Who restrained their hands from (fighting) you and your hands from (fighting) them right in Makkah (at Hudaybiyyah) after granting you dominance over them. Allaah is always Watchful over what you do.

In a lengthy narration, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mughaffal (RA) says, "As we remained there, thirty armed men left (Makkah) and attacked us by surprise. Rasulullaah ﷺ however prayed to Allaah and Allaah made them all deaf. (As they stood dumbstruck) We then got up and captured them. Rasulullaah ﷺ then asked them, "Have you men come under the protection of any treaty or has anyone granted you any amnesty?" When they replied in the negative, Rasulullaah ﷺ let them go. It was then that Allaah revealed the verse:

blocks.arabic_text: وَهُوَ الَّذِي كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِن بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا
blocks.text: It is Allaah Who restrained their hands from (fighting) you and your hands from (fighting) them right in Makkah (at Hudaybiyyah) after granting you dominance over them. Allaah is always Watchful over what you do.
Rasulullaah ﷺ's Tolerance with the Daus Tribe

Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) reports that Hadhrat Tufayl bin Amr (RA) of the Daus tribe once came to Rasulullaah ﷺ and said, "The Daus tribe are disobedient and refuse to accept (Islaam). Please curse them." Rasulullaah ﷺ then turned to face the Qibla and raised his hands (to pray), to which the Sahabah (RA) remarked, "Those people will certainly be destroyed." Rasulullaah ﷺ then prayed, "O Allaah! Guide the Daus tribe and bring them (to us as Muslims). O Allaah! Guide the Daus tribe and bring them. O Allaah! Guide the Daus tribe and bring them."[^3]

Hadhrat Abu Za'raa (RA) reports that Hadhrat Ali bin Abu Taalib (RA) used to say, "My pure wives, pious progeny and myself have been the most tolerant people in youth and the most learned as adults.
